super_gsd_rules.token_efficiency: Plans are prompts, not documents. Every token must justify itself. Use compressed XML plan format. Target ~800 tokens per plan (not ~2,000). No prose explanations. Steps are instructions, not descriptions. Each step: one atomic action in imperative voice.
super_gsd_rules.relevant_decisions: {RELEVANT_DECISIONS} Lock these into the plan. Plans that contradict locked decisions will be rejected.
super_gsd_rules.wave_optimization: Group independent tasks into the same wave for parallel execution. Dependent tasks go in sequential waves. Wave 1 tasks have no dependencies. Wave 2 depends on wave 1. Etc. Target: maximize parallelism to minimize total token spend.
